user.title: Voice Broadcast
user.description: Say "broadcast <message>" to Assist and hear your own voice on the speakers you choose. The two target lists together define where broadcasts go: list only the devices you want (mix of media players and satellites); when BOTH are empty, every device receives the broadcast. All other voice commands pass through unchanged.

data.output_dir: Recording folder (relative to the config directory, or absolute)
data.auto_broadcast: Broadcast automatically when a recording is made
data.agent: Assistant for normal commands (everything that is not a broadcast)
data.confirm: Confirmation spoken on the source satellite (empty = silent)
data.targets: Media player targets (leave both target lists empty = all devices)
data.satellites: Voice satellite targets (leave both target lists empty = all devices)
data.preannounce: Play the satellite chime before the announcement

error.upstream_not_found: The selected speech-to-text entity does not exist or is not set up.
